changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE insights ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID NOT NULL, type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, period_year INT NOT NULL, period_month INT NOT NULL, relevance_score DECIMAL(5,2), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', expires_at TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE INDEX idx_insights_user_active ON insights(user_id, status, created_at DESC);
